title: wedelia horsfieldiana
intro: Wedelia horsfieldiana, commonly known as Wedelia, is a flowering plant species native to tropical regions. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia horsfieldiana include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Wedelia horsfieldiana have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
